critical_disclosures: Original research ZIP is not accessible in this conversation runtime. This is an independently reconstructed reduced-scope route-candidate package.
Cebu Pacific sources were rendered without all route table contents; network transcription is drawn from completed Deep Research report, not newly directly downloaded route-table data.
Airport identities and coordinates were not available from the pinned OurAirports download. Join against existing pinned catalogue; blank cells are deliberately blank.
PAL W26 international PDF direct URL is referenced, but no timetable flights have been extracted into this replacement ZIP.
Published route candidates are not necessarily actual 2 November departures; use the exact origin/destination/date collector.

Returned sources have differing as-of dates; Clark airport page inspected here displayed August 10 2026 while previous research referred to a later edition. Treat it as a candidate source, not confirmation for 2 November.
Some Manila and Clark route assignments remain carrier-specific due to Cebgo transfer.
Emirates Dubai-Cebu-Clark-Dubai circular itinerary is asymmetric.
Iloilo-Singapore start-date evidence for Cebu Pacific is 23 November, but prior suspensions and other operators need further independent investigation.

route_hash_basis: Curated recovered candidates and input pins, not raw website bytes
